# Tette delle Monache — nunsbreasts.com

> International website of Tette delle Monache, the traditional pastry of Altamura (Puglia, southern Italy): a very light dome of sponge cake, filled with custard and dusted with icing sugar. The Italian name literally means "nuns' breasts" and refers to the pastry's shape and its convent origin. The website is under construction; the Italian version is at https://tettedellemonache.co/.

Useful information:

- Other names: tette della monaca, sospiri, sospiri pugliesi, sise delle monache (a similar pastry from Guardiagrele, Abruzzo).
- Tradition links the pastry to the Poor Clare nuns and to the Monastery of Saint Clare in Altamura's old town.
- Products, trade terms and contacts for retailers and distributors will be published soon.
